title: Macrophage- or neutrophil-expressed UPP1 drives tumor growth and immune suppression in the tumor microenvironment.
snippet: Uridine phosphorylase 1 (UPP1) has recently emerged as a metabolic regulator with critical roles in tumor cell biology. However, its expression pattern and functional significance in nonmalignant components of the tumor microenvironment (TME) remain largely unexplored.
